`AUDIT.md` is written, five findings, worst first. No service code touched.

`package.json` checks out against `NOTES.md` on three of four watched dependencies — `date-fmt`, `pg-lite`, and `redis-min` are all fine. `fast-parse` is the exception: still pinned at the yanked `1.4.2`, needs the bump to `1.4.3`.

The full write-up, in order:
1. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL built by string concatenation, filter and order-by unchecked.
2. `src/routes/internal.js` — metrics and cache-flush open to the internet since the VPN retired.
3. `package.json` — `fast-parse` still on the yanked, vulnerable `1.4.2`.
4. `config/staging.js` — real DB password committed in plain text.
5. `src/routes/accounts/login.js` — login itself requires being already logged in.
